clips.image: A plain dark steel box with a hinged lid on a scratched lab bench, a Geiger counter and a small glass flask beside it, a cat's two glowing eyes visible in the narrow gap under the lid
clips.motion: very slow push-in toward the gap, the eyes blink once, dust drifts in the lamp light, silent and tense

clips.image: Extreme close-up of a cat's eye, golden iris, the black pupil reflects a tiny glowing microchip with cyan circuit lines
clips.motion: slow push into the pupil, the reflected chip glows brighter, the pupil narrows

clips.image: A young woman in a dark room holds a smartphone close to her face, the screen lights her face cyan, her eyes focused, city lights bokeh behind the window
clips.motion: slow push past her shoulder into the phone screen, the screen glow blooms and fills the frame

clips.image: A cleanroom engineer in a white bunny suit and mask holds up a 300 mm silicon wafer, its surface shimmers with rainbow interference under amber safelight
clips.motion: slow tilt of the wafer so the rainbow sweeps across it, camera pushes toward the mirror-like surface

clips.image: Inside an automated semiconductor fab, endless corridor of tools, overhead rail transport pods racing along ceiling tracks
clips.motion: fast forward dolly down the corridor under the racing pods, kinetic, on the beat

clips.image: A huge dark AI server hall, rows of black GPU racks with blue status LEDs, heat shimmer rising above the racks, a young engineer with a tablet walking between rows
clips.motion: fast lateral tracking shot along the racks, LEDs pulse, heat haze ripples

clips.image: Extreme macro of a bare processor die with gold bond wires and microscopic circuit grids, rainbow thin-film colors
clips.motion: slow macro slide across the die surface, focus sweeps across the wires

clips.image: Extreme macro of a memory chip on a bare SSD circuit board, the chip edge cut open showing hundreds of thin stacked layers like a skyscraper
clips.motion: slow vertical crane up the layer stack, light glints across each layer

clips.image: A cat's paw resting on the lid of a dark steel box, thin beams of cold cyan light leaking from the cracks around the lid
clips.motion: the paw pushes the lid up a few millimetres, more light spills out, haze glows

clips.image: A packed dark club, crowd of young people with their phones raised high, cyan and violet laser beams slice the haze above them
clips.motion: handheld push through the crowd, phones sway to the beat, lasers sweep

clips.image: A sleek black cat walks through a wall of horizontal cyan laser beams in a dark hazy corridor, a faint translucent double of the cat already appears on the other side
clips.motion: tracking shot beside the cat as it passes through the laser wall, the ghost double flickers and solidifies

clips.image: A young woman dancing alone under a single cyan laser in a dark club, eyes closed, euphoric, hair moving
clips.motion: slow orbit around her as she spins, laser flickers on the beat, haze

clips.image: Close-up of the Sun's surface with boiling granulation and a huge arching plasma prominence against black space
clips.motion: slow push toward the prominence, plasma flows along the magnetic loop

clips.image: A gleaming gold dilution refrigerator chandelier of a superconducting quantum computer hanging in a dark lab, coaxial cables, cyan rim light, a young female physicist looking up at it
clips.motion: slow crane up the gold chandelier from the bottom stage, cables glint

clips.image: A scanning tunneling microscope tip, a needle sharpened to a single atom, hovering above a surface of glowing atom bumps in a perfect grid
clips.motion: slow macro glide of the tip across the atom grid, the atoms glow as it passes

clips.image: The lid of a dark steel box is open, the box is empty, only a soft glowing cyan static fills it, the lab is dark
clips.motion: slow push down into the empty glowing box, the static flickers and fades to black
